exposure: Antenatal booking status (booked at another Hospital Authority or private hospital vs. no booking)
Non-local pregnant women with no booking
Non-local pregnant women with a booking at another Hospital Authority or private hospital
outcome: Admission to special care baby unit
cohort: Non-local pregnant women (holding a People's Republic of China passport or two-way permit, or whose spouses were Hong Kong Identity Card holders) who delivered at Kwong Wah Hospital in Hong Kong between April 1st, 2011 and March 31st, 2012.
finding: Non-local pregnant women in Hong Kong were more likely to have higher parity, hypertensive disease, preterm deliveries, babies needing special care, and macrosomic babies, but they had lower rates of induction and cesarean section, and similar maternal and neonatal outcomes compared to those with bookings elsewhere.
